nodes.label: OTA firmware update
nodes.rationale: Triggered over MQTT, downloaded over HTTPS from GitHub Releases, verified with the ESP-IDF public CA bundle (no embedded cert, no local server). Wired centrally in components/common (mqtt_wrap + ota) so every board gets OTA with no per-module code.

nodes.label: MQTT Discovery
nodes.rationale: Entities appear in Home Assistant automatically via retained homeassistant/<component>/<board>/<object_id>/config messages; device block carries sw_version.

nodes.label: Last Will availability
nodes.rationale: Each board reports availability via a retained MQTT Last Will on home/<board>/status (online/offline); publishes online on connect.

nodes.label: dual-OTA partitions
nodes.rationale: partitions.csv defines ota_0/ota_1/otadata on 4 MB flash; requires WROOM-32 with 4 MB, first image must be flashed over USB.

nodes.label: bootloader rollback
nodes.rationale: A freshly-flashed image is only marked valid after it successfully reconnects to MQTT, so a broken build automatically reverts on the next reboot.

nodes.label: esp_https_ota over HTTPS (CA bundle)
nodes.rationale: Uses esp_https_ota with the public certificate bundle (CONFIG_MBEDTLS_CERTIFICATE_BUNDLE); binaries + per-board <board>.json manifest hosted on GitHub Releases.

nodes.label: ESP1 lights board
nodes.rationale: Relay light-switch board (env esp1_lights); in the measurement study is the plain-MQTT peer (1883).

nodes.label: ESP2 temperature board
nodes.rationale: DHT22 sensor + heater relay board (env esp2_temperature); in the measurement study is the MQTTS-TLS peer (8883).

nodes.label: plain-MQTT vs TLS measurement study
nodes.rationale: Compares ESP1 plain MQTT (1883) vs ESP2 MQTTS-TLS (8883) on handshake time, retained heap, on-wire packet size, and end-to-end RTT.
